# messq_completion

See `messq help exit-codes` for the exit-code contract.

## messq completion

emit the shell completion script (bash, zsh or fish)

### Synopsis

Emit the completion script for the named shell. Source it in your
shell's startup file, e.g.:

  source <(messq completion bash)

Completion never blocks a shell: live stream and consumer names are
fetched on a 200ms budget, and a dead or unauthorised daemon simply
completes nothing, silently.

```
messq completion <shell> [flags]
```

### Options

```
  -h, --help   help for completion
```
